                    阅读4分钟
                  </span> <!----></div></div> <div style="flex:1;" data-v-61fb5e44=""></div> <!----> <!----></div> <!----> <!----> <!----> <!----> <div id="article-root" itemprop="articleBody" class="main" data-v-61fb5e44=""><div class="article-viewer markdown-body result"><h2 data-id="heading-0">前言</h2>
<p>大家好，我是奈德丽。</p>
<p>过去一年，我主要参与<strong>国际机票业务</strong>的开发工作，因此每天都要和多语言（i18n）打交道。熟悉我的朋友都知道，我这个人比较“惜力”(并不是，实际上只是忍不下去了)，对于<strong>重复笨拙的工作非常抵触</strong>，于是，我开始思考如何优化团队的多语言管理模式。</p>
<h2 data-id="heading-1">痛点背景</h2>
<p>先说说我们在<strong>机票项目</strong>中遇到的困境。</p>
<p>目前机票项目分为 H5 和 PC 两端，团队在维护多语言时主要通过<strong>在线 Excel</strong>进行管理：</p>
<ul>
<li>一个 Excel 文件，H5 和 PC 各自占一个 sheet 页；</li>
<li>每次更新语言，需要先导出 Excel，然后手动跑脚本生成语言文件，再拷贝到项目中。</li>
</ul>
<p>听起来还算凑合，但随着项目规模的扩大，问题逐渐显现：</p>
<ol>
<li>
<p><strong>Key 命名混乱</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>有的首字母大写，有的小驼峰、大驼峰混用；</li>
<li>没有统一规则，难以模块化管理。</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>不支持模块化</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>目前已有<strong>数千条 key</strong>；</li>
<li>查找、修改、维护都非常痛苦。</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>更新流程繁琐</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>需要手动进入脚本目录，用 <code>node</code> 跑脚本；</li>
<li>生成后再<strong>手动复制</strong>到项目中。</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ol>
<p>下面是一个实际的 Excel 片段，可以感受一下当时的混乱程度：</p>
<p><img src="https://p9-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/30342b62897248efb0fb9f78f559db09~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5aWI5b635Li9:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1766462725&amp;x-signature=IvK%2FMD6KMEe30RuMsDUsCAGVy0c%3D" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>用原node脚本生成的语言文件如图</p>
<p><img src="https://p9-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/d165f4848ff64c35ba6190010a202914~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5aWI5b635Li9:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1766462725&amp;x-signature=z5d9zqz6%2B82C91fTr0xHFa0f9cw%3D" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>在这样的场景下，<strong>每次迭代多语言文件更新都像噩梦一样</strong>。<br>
尤其是我们很多翻译是通过<strong>AI 机翻</strong>生成，后续频繁修改的成本极高。</p>
<p>然而，机票项目的代码量太大、历史包袱太重，短期内<strong>几乎不可能彻底改造</strong>。</p>
<p><img src="https://p9-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/5dd64ac9fa3d4b40880d97313fd8d719~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5aWI5b635Li9:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1766462725&amp;x-signature=UcnLkeRDwpN7KtKBeKEmKF2q11s%3D" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 data-id="heading-2">新项目，新机会</h2>
<p>机票项目虽然不能动，但在我们启动<strong>酒店业务新项目</strong>时，我决定不能再重蹈覆辙。<br>
因此，在酒店项目中，我从零搭建了这套更高效的 i18n 管理方案。</p>
<p>目标很简单：</p>
<ol>
<li><strong>统一 key 规则</strong>，支持模块化，模块与内容间用.隔开，内容之间用下划线隔开；</li>
<li><strong>自动化生成</strong>多语言 JSON 文件，集成到项目内，不再需要查找转化脚本的位置；</li>
<li><strong>一条命令搞定</strong>更新，不需要手动拷贝。</li>
</ol>
<p>于是，我在项目中新增了一个 <code>scripts</code> 目录，并编写了一个 <code>excel-to-json.js</code> 脚本。<br>
在 <code>package.json</code> 中添加如下命令：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-json" lang="json"><span class="hljs-punctuation">{</span>
  <span class="hljs-attr">"scripts"</span><span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span> <span class="hljs-punctuation">{</span>
    <span class="hljs-attr">"i18n:excel-to-json"</span><span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span> <span class="hljs-string">"node scripts/excel-to-json.js"</span>
  <span class="hljs-punctuation">}</span>
<span class="hljs-punctuation">}</span>
</code></pre>
<p>以后，只需要运行下面一行命令，就能完成所有工作：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-vbnet" lang="vbnet">pnpm i18n:excel-<span class="hljs-keyword">to</span>-json
</code></pre>
<p>再也不用手动寻找脚本路径，也不用手动复制粘贴，<strong>效率直接起飞 🚀</strong>。</p>
<h2 data-id="heading-3">脚本实现</h2>
<p>核心逻辑就是：<br>
<strong>从 Excel 读取内容 → 转换为 JSON → 输出到项目 i18n 目录</strong>。</p>
<p>完整代码如下：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> fs <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'node:fs'</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> os <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'node:os'</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> path <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'node:path'</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> <span class="hljs-variable constant_">XLSX</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'xlsx'</span>

<span class="hljs-comment">/**
 * 语言映射表：Excel 表头 -&gt; 标准语言码
 */</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> languageMap = {
  <span class="hljs-string">'English'</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'en'</span>,
  <span class="hljs-string">'简中'</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'zh-CN'</span>,
  <span class="hljs-string">'Chinese (Traditional)'</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'zh-TW'</span>,
  <span class="hljs-string">'Korean'</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'ko'</span>,
  <span class="hljs-string">'Spanish'</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'es'</span>,
  <span class="hljs-string">'German Edited'</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'de'</span>,
  <span class="hljs-string">'Italian'</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'it'</span>,
  <span class="hljs-string">'Norwegian'</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'no'</span>,
  <span class="hljs-string">'French'</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'fr'</span>,
  <span class="hljs-string">'Arabic'</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'ar'</span>,
  <span class="hljs-string">'Thailandese'</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'th'</span>,
  <span class="hljs-string">'Malay'</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'ms'</span>,
}

<span class="hljs-comment">// 读取 Excel 文件</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">readExcel</span>(<span class="hljs-params">filePath</span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (!fs.<span class="hljs-title function_">existsSync</span>(filePath)) {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">throw</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Error</span>(<span class="hljs-string">`❌ Excel 文件未找到: <span class="hljs-subst">${filePath}</span>`</span>)
  }
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> workbook = <span class="hljs-variable constant_">XLSX</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">readFile</span>(filePath)
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> sheet = workbook.<span class="hljs-property">Sheets</span>[workbook.<span class="hljs-property">SheetNames</span>[<span class="hljs-number">0</span>]]
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-variable constant_">XLSX</span>.<span class="hljs-property">utils</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">sheet_to_json</span>(sheet)
}

<span class="hljs-comment">/**
 * 清空输出目录
 */</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">clearOutputDir</span>(<span class="hljs-params">dirPath</span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (fs.<span class="hljs-title function_">existsSync</span>(dirPath)) {
    fs.<span class="hljs-title function_">readdirSync</span>(dirPath).<span class="hljs-title function_">forEach</span>(<span class="hljs-function"><span class="hljs-params">file</span> =&gt;</span> fs.<span class="hljs-title function_">unlinkSync</span>(path.<span class="hljs-title function_">join</span>(dirPath, file)))
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-string">`🧹 已清空目录: <span class="hljs-subst">${dirPath}</span>`</span>)
  } <span class="hljs-keyword">else</span> {
    fs.<span class="hljs-title function_">mkdirSync</span>(dirPath, { <span class="hljs-attr">recursive</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">true</span> })
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-string">`📂 创建目录: <span class="hljs-subst">${dirPath}</span>`</span>)
  }
}

<span class="hljs-comment">/**
 * 生成 JSON 文件
 */</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">generateLocales</span>(<span class="hljs-params">rows, outputDir</span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> locales = {}

  rows.<span class="hljs-title function_">forEach</span>(<span class="hljs-function"><span class="hljs-params">row</span> =&gt;</span> {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> key = row.<span class="hljs-property">Key</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (!key) <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span>

    <span class="hljs-comment">// 遍历语言列</span>
    <span class="hljs-title class_">Object</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">entries</span>(languageMap).<span class="hljs-title function_">forEach</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">[columnName, langCode]</span>) =&gt;</span> {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (!locales[langCode]) locales[langCode] = {}

      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> value = row[columnName] || <span class="hljs-string">''</span>
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> keys = key.<span class="hljs-title function_">split</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'.'</span>)
      <span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> current = locales[langCode]

      keys.<span class="hljs-title function_">forEach</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">k, idx</span>) =&gt;</span> {
        <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (idx === keys.<span class="hljs-property">length</span> - <span class="hljs-number">1</span>) {
          current[k] = value
        } <span class="hljs-keyword">else</span> {
          current[k] = current[k] || {}
          current = current[k]
        }
      })
    })
  })

  <span class="hljs-comment">// 输出文件</span>
  <span class="hljs-title class_">Object</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">entries</span>(locales).<span class="hljs-title function_">forEach</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">[lang, data]</span>) =&gt;</span> {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> filePath = path.<span class="hljs-title function_">join</span>(outputDir, <span class="hljs-string">`<span class="hljs-subst">${lang}</span>.json`</span>)
    fs.<span class="hljs-title function_">writeFileSync</span>(filePath, <span class="hljs-title class_">JSON</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">stringify</span>(data, <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>, <span class="hljs-number">2</span>), <span class="hljs-string">'utf-8'</span>)
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-string">`✅ 生成文件: <span class="hljs-subst">${filePath}</span>`</span>)
  })
}

<span class="hljs-comment">/**
 * 检测缺失翻译
 */</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">detectMissingTranslations</span>(<span class="hljs-params">rows</span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> missing = []
  rows.<span class="hljs-title function_">forEach</span>(<span class="hljs-function"><span class="hljs-params">row</span> =&gt;</span> {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> key = row.<span class="hljs-property">Key</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (!key) <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span>

    <span class="hljs-title class_">Object</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">entries</span>(languageMap).<span class="hljs-title function_">forEach</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">[columnName, langCode]</span>) =&gt;</span> {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> value = row[columnName]
      <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (!value?.<span class="hljs-title function_">trim</span>()) {
        missing.<span class="hljs-title function_">push</span>({ key, <span class="hljs-attr">lang</span>: langCode })
      }
    })
  })
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> missing
}

<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">logMissingTranslations</span>(<span class="hljs-params">missingList</span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (missingList.<span class="hljs-property">length</span> === <span class="hljs-number">0</span>) {
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'\n🎉 所有 key 的翻译完整！'</span>)
    <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span>
  }

  <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">warn</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'\n⚠️ 以下 key 缺少翻译:'</span>)
  missingList.<span class="hljs-title function_">forEach</span>(<span class="hljs-function"><span class="hljs-params">item</span> =&gt;</span> {
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">warn</span>(<span class="hljs-string">`  - key: "<span class="hljs-subst">${item.key}</span>" 缺少语言: <span class="hljs-subst">${item.lang}</span>`</span>)
  })
}

<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">main</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> desktopPath = path.<span class="hljs-title function_">join</span>(os.<span class="hljs-title function_">homedir</span>(), <span class="hljs-string">'Desktop'</span>, <span class="hljs-string">'hotel多语言.xlsx'</span>)
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> outputDir = path.<span class="hljs-title function_">resolve</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'src/i18n/locales'</span>)

  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> rows = <span class="hljs-title function_">readExcel</span>(desktopPath)
  <span class="hljs-title function_">clearOutputDir</span>(outputDir)
  <span class="hljs-title function_">generateLocales</span>(rows, outputDir)
  <span class="hljs-title function_">logMissingTranslations</span>(<span class="hljs-title function_">detectMissingTranslations</span>(rows))
}

<span class="hljs-title function_">main</span>()
</code></pre>
<h2 data-id="heading-4">成果展示</h2>
<p>这是在线语言原文档</p>
<p><img src="https://p9-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/25b7049f994e428f977c415c87fa1b55~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5aWI5b635Li9:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1766462725&amp;x-signature=2J5LXjuZiAtOUEoEj3AgLbqFOYQ%3D" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>这是生成后的多语言文件和内容
<img src="https://p9-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/f725c4942dc34227b00add056c1da83a~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5aWI5b635Li9:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1766462725&amp;x-signature=rT2A50GTAs0w%2BdgDCMtAqHjjVT8%3D" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>现在的工作流大幅简化：</p>






























<table><thead><tr><th>操作</th><th>旧流程</th><th>新流程</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>运行脚本</td><td>手动找脚本路径</td><td><code>pnpm i18n:excel-to-json</code></td></tr><tr><td>文件生成位置</td><td>生成后手动拷贝</td><td>自动输出到项目</td></tr><tr><td>检测缺失翻译</td><td>无</td><td>自动提示</td></tr><tr><td>key 命名管理</td><td>无统一规则</td><td>模块化、规范化</td></tr></tbody></table>
<p>这套机制目前在<strong>酒店项目</strong>中运行良好，团队反馈也很积极。</p>
<h2 data-id="heading-5">总结</h2>
<p>这次改造让我最大的感触是：</p>
<blockquote>
<p><strong>旧项目难以推翻重来，但新项目一定要趁早做好架构设计。</strong></p>
</blockquote>
<p>通过这次优化，我们不仅解决了多语言维护的痛点，还提升了团队整体开发效率。<br>
而这套方案在未来如果机票项目有机会重构，也可以直接平滑迁移过去。</p></div></div>
